title: Concept: Container runs as root in dockerfile — review required
description: In dockerfile, the image sets USER root. The application process keeps full control of the container filesystem, so a compromise can rewrite binaries, install persistence, and reach any mounted secret. Runtime restrictions help, but starting unprivileged removes the easiest escalation path after a container breakout.
applicability: dockerfile container images that serve application traffic.
risk: Privilege escalation inside the container and easier lateral movement; MEDIUM severity.
